attributes.name: heading_and_nav_text_color
attributes.definition: The color used for headings and navigation link text on the page.

values.definition: Headings and nav link text are deep navy.
Headings and nav text are black or dark neutral gray.
Headings and nav text use a saturated brand accent color.

attributes.name: primary_cta_color_role
attributes.definition: How color is allocated to primary call-to-action buttons relative to the rest of the page.

values.definition: A distinct accent color is used almost exclusively for primary CTAs.
The CTA color is also used for many other non-CTA elements.
CTAs use a neutral or dark color with no special accent.

attributes.name: metric_value_color_coding
attributes.definition: How numeric metric or score values are colored.

values.definition: Values are colored by thresholds such as green, orange, red by good/mid/bad.
All metric values share one color.
Metric values use a brand accent color regardless of value.

attributes.name: navy_section_band
attributes.definition: Presence of a full-width section band filled with deep navy.
